comment: Read from the repository at commit 39d9429, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.1.0. The three outputs are wired across the three coordinates, which the maker marks in the source with the comment cruzados: the jack printed X carries z, the jack printed Y carries x and the jack printed Z carries y, at lines 141 to 143. The other two modules in this plugin are wired straight through, so this is particular to Lorentz84. All three are multiplied by 2.5 after a direct-voltage blocker and none is clamped, so no output range is given. The constant a is fixed at 0.25 and has no control. The maker's comment beside F reads 7.3 to 10 while the line computes 7.4 to 10; the line above follows the code. The runaway guard at line 122 tests each coordinate against 12 and drops the system back to 0.1 on all three. Every port is single channel.
